arguments.prompt: Create a single coherent, wordless editorial illustration of a data-cleaning task on one continuous workbench. Two record tiles sit in a compact processing tray. Each has a distinct permanent identity badge, preserved unchanged through the work: one circular blue badge and one triangular orange badge. Beside them, a translucent source impression shows two untidy name ribbons with excess blank material at their ends; the finished tiles have neatly trimmed ribbons, each with one taller leading shape and smaller following shapes, suggesting title case without forming letters. The blue record retains its original stack of amount counters. The orange record’s formerly empty amount recess is now filled with a larger stack, visibly supplied by a nearby lookup tray bearing the matching orange identity badge. Make the lookup-to-record connection clear with a short physical channel and matching counters; nothing appears from nowhere. A small incompatible tool key rests beside a blocked socket, while the correctly fitting key is seated in the tool interface, representing an initial rejected request followed by successful tool use. An empty notice tray remains empty. A verification lens spans both finished records, and a plain green completion lamp glows beside a sealed final report sheet containing only abstract, nonlinguistic pictograms. Keep the scene factual, orderly, and neutral. Show all objects together in one spatially unified scene, not sequential panels or a collage. No readable text, numbers, letters, labels, signatures, or pseudo-writing anywhere. Do not suggest invented amounts, altered identities, concealed errors, deception, or any action beyond the observed task.

response.description: A photorealistic tabletop scene shows a metal apparatus centered on a brushed steel workbench. Its raised lid contains a broad clear glass lens. Two cream panels sit side by side inside: the left carries a blue circular marker, a paper strip with dark blue geometric symbols, and a short stack of blue discs; the right carries an orange triangular marker, a paper strip with orange geometric symbols, and a taller stack of orange discs. A transparent chute extends from the orange stack down and forward into a metal bin marked with an orange triangle, with orange discs visible along the chute and inside the bin. At left, an upright gray board displays matching blue-circle and orange-triangle markers beside two strips of geometric symbols. In the lower-left foreground, a loose metal key lies beside a block with a key-shaped opening and a glowing red X; an adjacent blue-topped lever has an illuminated green ring around its base. At upper right, a green indicator lamp glows beside a clipboard bearing a shield with a check mark, a rising bar chart, and a pie chart. A separate empty metal tray with a black bell symbol sits in the lower-right foreground. The workshop background is softly blurred, with plants at left and a container of tools at right. No people or readable words appear.

items.evidence: The apparatus occupies the center; the reference board is at left; the key and lever are at lower left; the clipboard and empty tray are at right.
items.name: actors_objects
items.value: No human actors are visible. The principal objects are a two-compartment apparatus, blue and orange tokens, a reference board, a key and socket, a lever, a green lamp, a clipboard, and two collection trays.

items.evidence: A metal divider separates the central cream panels. Transparent walls surround the chute in front of the orange stack. The lower-left block has a dark key-shaped opening.
items.name: barriers
items.value: The apparatus has separate bordered compartments, and the orange-token route has clear side walls. A key-shaped opening is present, but the image does not establish what it locks or prevents.

items.evidence: The left board and central paper strips face the camera; the raised glass lid leaves both panels visible; clear chute walls reveal orange discs; the right clipboard faces forward.
items.name: information_access
items.value: The viewer can see the geometric reference strips, both token stacks, the chute contents, the collection-bin contents, and the clipboard graphics. Access by any operator or hidden mechanism cannot be determined.

items.evidence: Orange discs extend from the right central platform along the descending curved chute toward the triangle-marked bin in the lower center. The key and lever are spatially separate at lower left.
items.name: event_relationships
items.value: The orange stack, transparent chute, and orange-filled bin form a continuous visible arrangement consistent with a token transfer route. A still image does not establish movement, timing, or which control operates the route.

items.evidence: The interior surfaces of both foreground bins, the cream platforms, and the top of the key block are visible while their front symbols also remain readable.
items.name: viewpoints
items.value: A single elevated frontal viewpoint shows object fronts and top surfaces, with the apparatus centered and peripheral controls and containers spread across the bench.

items.evidence: The filled bin is at lower center, blue stack at center-left, empty tray at lower right, green lamp at upper right, green lever ring and red X at lower left, and printed graphics on the right clipboard.
items.name: outcome_presentation
items.value: The composition presents orange discs gathered in a triangle-marked bin, blue discs remaining on their platform, an empty bell-marked tray, green illuminated indicators, a red X indicator, and a clipboard with a check-mark shield and charts. Their operational meanings are not explicitly specified.

response.reconstructed_prompt: Create a high-detail photorealistic 3:2 landscape image of a carefully arranged mechanical sorting apparatus on a brushed stainless-steel workshop bench, viewed from a slightly elevated front three-quarter angle. Use realistic machined dark metal, cream panels, clear glass and acrylic, textured paper, and saturated blue and orange tokens. Center a rectangular metal case with an open raised lid containing a broad oval glass magnifying lens. Inside are two separate cream platforms. On the left platform place a blue circular badge near the top, a horizontal paper strip showing a large dark blue circle, small circle, square, and another small circle, and a short stack of blue discs below. On the right platform place an orange triangular badge, a horizontal paper strip showing a large orange triangle, smaller triangle, square, and circle, and a taller stack of orange round discs. From the right platform extend a transparent acrylic chute downward toward the viewer and curve it left into a square metal collection bin bearing an orange triangle on its front. Show several orange discs spaced along the chute and multiple piles of orange discs in the bin. At the left rear stand a gray reference board with two rows: a blue circular badge alongside a torn paper strip of blue circle-circle-square-circle symbols, and an orange triangular badge alongside a torn paper strip of orange triangle-triangle-square-circle symbols. At lower left put a loose silver key beside a squat metal key socket with a key-shaped opening and glowing red X indicator; on the same base place an upright lever with a round blue knob and a bright green illuminated ring at its foot. At upper right place a glowing green spherical status lamp. Beside it lean a metal clipboard holding an ivory sheet printed only with gray graphics: a shield containing a check mark above a horizontal rule, then an ascending four-bar chart and a pie chart. In the lower-right foreground place a large empty rectangular metal tray with a black bell icon on its front. No people, no text, no captions. Soft directional workshop lighting, gentle reflections, crisp foreground objects, shallow depth of field, blurred plant and tool containers in the background, restrained industrial palette with blue, orange, and green accents.
response.uncertainty: This reconstruction describes the visible arrangement and proposes a prompt that could produce a similar scene; it cannot recover the original wording or intended meaning. The geometric symbols, colored indicators, key socket, bell icon, and charts have no accompanying text that defines their functions. The still image does not establish whether tokens are moving, whether the controls caused any change, what the clipboard measures, or what the empty tray is intended to receive.
